title_zh: 先索取会堂维修分项报价再决定活动规模

scenario.label_zh: 先索取会堂维修分项报价再决定活动规模
scenario.goal_zh: 说明维修费用可能影响活动预算，并约定先取得分项报价再作缩减决定

context_zh: 社区会堂筹备人员面对尚未正式报价的维修事项，讨论活动预算安排。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Greta
sentences.text: The repair costs loom over every decision about the autumn event. Are we going to have to cancel it?

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: We don't know the magnitude of the bill yet. The caretaker gave us a rough figure, not a written quote.

sentences.speaker: Greta
sentences.text: Could some of the work wait until after the event?

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: We need the contractor to identify what's required before the hall can be used. Let's not assume any of it can wait.

sentences.speaker: Greta
sentences.text: I'll ask for an itemized quote and a clear distinction between work needed for use and optional improvements.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Good. Then we can decide whether a smaller event is possible, rather than canceling on the basis of a guess.

targets.sense_zh: 令人担忧地逼近或笼罩
